title: Likely bug in sending duration for profileSwitch, mongodb has different duration value
symptom: When extracting data from mongodb for Profile Switch events, the duration is not properly represented in milliseconds and seems to have a dual conversion from minutes to milliseconds (60*1000 * 60*1000). The duration on mongodb is reported as 2592000000000 which equals 720 mins if divided by (60*1000 * 60*1000). The user wonders if this bug is related to profiles not switching off.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state the root cause, but the issue is identified as a bug in the duration conversion.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit referenced in the thread: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/9b90eea7740e86d8e614ce3b6b98a912348e2668
